messages:
Noah Kim: Hi folks, first morning. My M2 MacBook arrived and jamf says 'Managed by Redwood Inference' but when I try to install Docker it fails with a kernel extension error: 'kext rejected due to system integrity protection'. The installer asks to run csrutil disable in Recovery. Should I do that?

Leon (IT): Welcome! :wave: Don't disable SIP unless we coordinate. Which Docker build did you get and what's the exact error? Can you paste the installer log snippet?

Noah Kim: Using Docker Desktop stable from company package. Error: 'SystemExtensions framework: approval required, kext com.docker.driver.amd64 rejected, reason: kext requires reduced security'. Installer log shows 'kext author not approved by policy'.

Marissa - Mac Admin: On M1/M2 we shouldn't disable SIP. We have a Jamf-approved policy that sets reduced security to allow our signed driver and creates the system extension approval profile. Looks like your device didn't receive that profile. Run `profiles status -type configuration` and `sudo softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license` (Rosetta may not be needed but ok).

Noah Kim: `profiles status -type configuration` -> "No configuration profiles installed". I did the Rosetta command and it said not required.

Leon (IT): Hm enrollment must have missed post-enroll. Can you run `sudo jamf policy -trigger post_enroll` and paste output? If it fails we'll lift staging-hold and push the kext profile.

Noah Kim: Running: `Executing policy post_enroll... Installing configuration profiles... ERROR: Could not install profile 'com.redwood.security.sysext' - 403`

Marissa - Mac Admin: 403 means staging-hold or mismatch. Are you on company VPN or in-office? We only allow automated reduced security changes from trusted networks.

Noah Kim: Remote, on company VPN via FortiClient.

Leon (IT): Forti can block some MDM callbacks. Marissa, can you check device serial C02ZQ9ABC123 and lift staging hold for this serial? I'll monitor.

deploy-bot: Jamf action 'lift-staging-hold' queued by Marissa for device C02ZQ9ABC123 at 2026-10-02T09:08:00Z.

Marissa - Mac Admin: Lifted staging-hold and re-sent post_enroll. Try `sudo jamf policy -trigger post_enroll` again.

Noah Kim: Re-ran it: Installing profile 'com.redwood.security.sysext'... Success. Reboot required to finalize reduced security change.

Leon (IT): Reboot and then try Docker install again. We should not need SIP disabled. We'll revoke any temp admin if we grant it.

Noah Kim: Rebooted, Docker installed cleanly, all good. Thanks y'all! :grin:
